title.narrative: Instutional Capacity Building for Monitoring Judicial Efficiency IDF Grant

description.narrative: The grant will finance: 1. Development of an automated system for collectingcomma processing and maintaining of court statistics and to monitor performance indicators. This component would assist in re-designing data collection strategies and instruments in order to make it an effective tool for court presidents and the MOJ for court administration and planning purposes. Once the new strategies and instruments are preparedcomma they will be discussed with court presidents and the MOJ officialscomma and written instructions for data collectioncomma auditing and reporting will be prepared and forwarded to the courts. The new instruments and procedures will be prepared with automation in mindcomma and some equipment and software will be provided to the MOJ and several country courts for implementing the new data management system. Under this componentcomma a series of training seminars will be conducted to show court presidentscomma judges and kancels (registrars) how statistical information can be used to manage courts more effectively. 2. Development of workload modules and other judicial performance indicators to effectively monitor caseloads and judicial performance. This component will assist in revising the existing time standardscomma workload modules and other indicators for judges. These parameters or modules must determine the workload that each type of court can reasonably manage. For the modules to be effectivecomma they must be continuously adapted to the different types of proceedings which might be adopted in the court system. The component will support training to the MOJ staff and court presidents focusing on the task of reviewing and revising the modules to keep them up to date. 3. Institutional strengthening of the Supreme Courtcomma judicial councils within large county courts and the MOJ staff in the area of monitoring judicial performance and conducting data analysis. The assistance would be provided through: (a) advisory services to the Department for the Administration of Justice and Human Resources in the Judiciary of the MOJ and training to its staff in the area of statistical data analysiscomma empirical research as a tool of effective performance monitoring and designing policy changes. The component will include study tours to observe the systems effectively functioning in other countries; (b) advisory services and training to the Supreme Court leadership in the area of statistical data managementcomma particularlycomma for the purposes of possible re-assignment of cases from one court to another The Supreme Court has been granted the right to reallocate cases from #overburdened# to #under-burdened# courtscomma but has not been able to effectively use this measures due to the lack of regular and comprehensive data on caseloads in various courts.; and (c) training to judicial councils of selected country courts in the area of using statistical data for evaluation of judges#
